description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, the Firebrand onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Novice Pyromancer to your hand.
+1 Chandra, the Firebrand targeting an opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Novice Pyromancer onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, the Firebrand to your hand.
-1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
